weight_rule: Equal opening notional across the seven previously identified research securities. Research convention selected retrospectively.
session_return_rule: Arithmetic mean of regular-session close/open minus one for each security. Require all seven final regular-session closes on the same raw-share basis as their opens. Verify any within-session corporate action before use. Excludes overnight returns and dividends.
note: Secondary-vendor opens, pending primary venue reconciliation. Intraday last trades appearing in historical close columns excluded. No realized basket return or stress score.
